first_manipulation_failure.uncertainty: Recovery changes depth, centering and orientation together; no single grasp parameter cause isolated.

recovered_phases.observation: Re-centered, differently oriented grasp retains and lifts frame.

later_failures.evidence: Frame insertion stops 50.44 then 36.58 mm short. Release reaches its pose, withdrawal remains 93.78 mm short; frame assembly never passes.
Astra observes shifted frame and re-measures. Subsequent descent remains 21.16 mm short. Release/withdraw targets arrive closely, but tool falls; Astra explicitly acknowledges failure.
Recovery lift stalls 61.80 then 151.51 mm short with tool caught on stand shaft. Astra releases and clears hand.

terminal_failure.evidence: Public terminal image shows tool low at the stand shaft rather than suspended on horizontal hook. Both native task relations fail and neither ever passed.
terminal_failure.completion_judgment: Correct failure acknowledgment; no false full-success claim. Describing frame as upright does not establish native seating.
